general.switchLayoutAfterConvertDescription: The layout follows the converted text so you can keep typing

emptyState.description: Add an Arabic layout in System Settings so conversion can work.

tryIt.title: Try it here
tryIt.caption: Uses your actual layouts and the same conversion as in your apps; nothing you type here is kept.
tryIt.label: Text to try

exceptions.description: Baddel stays out of these apps — password managers, terminals and the like.
exceptions.emptyStateDescription: Baddel currently works in every app.

about.copyDiagnosticsDescription: Version, system, layouts and recent outcomes — never any text you typed
about.promise: Fully local · No account · No tracking · One permission

welcome.title:
Typed with the wrong layout?
Baddel fixes it in one press.
welcome.body: Between Arabic and English, in any app you type in.
welcome.moveBody: Baddel is running from the disk image or Downloads. Move it, then open it from Applications so permission and updates keep working.

how.title: How it works
how.body: Three moments — no menus, no copy and paste.
how.note: Press again within two seconds to reach one more word back. One Undo puts everything back.

permission.title: One permission, for one reason
permission.body: Baddel needs Accessibility to read what you select and replace it in the app you’re typing in.
permission.noServer: Never sends your text to a server
permission.path: In System Settings → Privacy & Security → Accessibility, turn on Baddel.

practice.title: Try Baddel
practice.body: The word below was typed in the wrong layout. Put the cursor after it and press your shortcut.
practice.successBody: Use it in any app — it’s always in your menu bar.
practice.nothingBody: Make sure “Baddel” is on in Accessibility and the cursor sits right after the word, then press your shortcut again.
practice.secureTitle: Another app turned on Secure Input
practice.secureBody: A password field is open somewhere. Baddel stays out until it closes — that’s by design.

hud.failed: Couldn’t convert here — select the text and try again
hud.noLayouts: Couldn’t read your layouts — open Settings → Layouts
hud.noPermission: Baddel needs permission — open its menu
hud.notHere: Converted text isn’t here — copy the original from the menu

permission.grantedDescription: Accessibility — Baddel is ready in every app
permission.missingDescription: The shortcut won’t work until it’s granted
permission.checkingDescription: Turn on “Baddel” in the Accessibility list

recorder.conflict: This shortcut is used by another app

updateDialog.availableTitle: A New Version of Baddel Is Available
updateDialog.availableBody: Version {version} is available — you have {current}. Baddel restarts after installing.
updateDialog.failedBody: Check your internet connection, then try again.

report.title: Report a Problem
report.intro: Describe what happened. Nothing is sent until you’ve seen it and confirmed.
report.descriptionPlaceholder: Example: in Mail I selected a paragraph and pressed the shortcut, but only half of it changed.
report.descriptionHint: Mention the app you were typing in, what you expected, and what happened.
report.imageWarning: The image may contain private text — check it before sending.
report.imageLimits: PNG or JPEG up to 20 MB, prepared automatically to under 3 MB without its metadata.

imageErrors.unsupported: That isn’t a PNG or JPEG image.
imageErrors.too-large: The image is larger than 20 MB.
imageErrors.no-image: There’s no image on the clipboard.

report.previewIntro: This is exactly what will be sent — nothing else.
report.previewDestination: It goes to a private repository owned by Baddel’s developer, through a server on Cloudflare.
report.onlyThis: Nothing else is sent: no text you typed or converted, no clipboard contents, no identifier for you or your device.
report.sentBody: Thank you. It goes straight to the developer and stays private.
report.keepNumber: Keep this number if you want to follow up — it’s your only reference.
report.failedRetry: Check your internet connection, then try again. The report is still here and hasn’t been saved anywhere else.
report.failedRateLimited: Too many reports came from your network. Try again in {minutes} minutes.
report.failedRejected: The server refused this report ({reason}). Copy it and send it your own way.
report.copyHint: “Copy Report” puts its full text on the clipboard, with the image described by its size, so you can send it your own way.

items.versions: Baddel and macOS versions, processor type
items.layouts: The two layout identifiers and names
items.history: Last 10 outcomes: result, path and time — no text
items.frontmost: The app identifier on the last attempt
items.settings: General settings; exceptions as a count only

diagnostics.never: Never any text you typed or converted, clipboard contents, or an identifier for you or your Mac.
diagnostics.sameInReports: The same diagnostics go with every report, and you see them in full before sending.
